C2_difference_from_C1: the frozen V5 C0 recipe (RGB only, no depth bypass) on TRAIN72; secondary, never a gate
anchor_control: anchor RGB + anchor depth, same full-role context-camera-derived bounds; a single view never reaches the >=2-view lifting support, so an anchor state of C1/C2 carries the single-view depth bypass and learned priors only

depth_bypass.inputs: context RGB, measured context depth, context cameras; no query
depth_bypass.placement: after the >=2-view support gate: one measured view suffices
depth_bypass.sampling: nearest pixel of the full-resolution measured ray-distance map

only_difference_C0_C1: C1 differs from C0 only by its frozen TRAIN set: 72 scenes (the 24 V2-V5 scenes plus 48 validated TRAIN-X scenes, volume disjoint from DEV and FRESH-V1) versus the 24; the frozen V5 C1 recipe (measured-depth bypass, surface loss), per-seed initialization, 6000-step budget, renderer and bounds rule are identical. The data stream differs between TRAIN sets by design.
state: query-independent; all DEV states sealed before query load; >=2 queries/state
test_time_input: RGB+DEPTH+CAMERA for C0/C1; C2 reads RGB+CAMERA only
